Apply Now
  • Guidelines
  • Requirements
  1. Register and log in to the portal.
  2. Fill in the application form and upload the documents.
  3. Track the application with the reference number.
    1. Documents to be enclosed with the application:
      1. Address Proof [Mandatory]
      2. Identity Proof [Mandatory]
      3. Salary Slip [Optional]
      4. Upload Scanned Copy of the Application Form [ Mandatory (incase of applying from PFC/CSC)]
      5. Caste proof
      Fees/Charges
      • User/Statutory charges -Rs. 30
      • Printing charge (in case of any printing from PFC/CSC) -Rs. 10 Per Page
      • Convenience fee- Rs. 10/-
      • Subject to rules
